blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver three bounded repairs: restore readable authored-arena spatial framing, make the ordinary five-wave/build transaction route closure-ready, and keep dense profiling bounded and honest for native-host qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: Three independent release-convergence failures remain. ArenaCamera coverage still reports authored gameplay geometry as an occluder despite the intended visibility separation. The ordinary route remains fixture-driven rather than a clean authoritative five-wave progression. Dense qualification is correctly blocked by unavailable native-renderer evidence, with no new candidate-side defect proven.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package, retained gameplay collision, lantern runtime/audio ownership, and passing native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines.
Do not claim dense qualification or alter the native-renderer gate when the host cannot provide native 1920x1080 evidence.
Do not add diagnostic tester actions to release behavior or use fixture branches as ordinary-route proof.

strategy.rationale: The camera issue has repeated transform-oriented treatments, so use explicit camera-visibility isolation and bound visual/collision pairing rather than another transform tune. The wave issue has repeated evidence-only treatments, so repair authoritative ordinary progression and transaction ownership. The dense issue has no proven candidate defect and requires unavailable external native evidence, so preserve its contract and limit edits to demonstrable workload/lifecycle bounds without falsifying qualification.

code: Run candidate import/boot and focused static checks for camera visibility-mask bindings, ordinary-route eligibility and terminal guards, upgrade current/result payloads, and release guards on tester_dense actions.
Verify each required gap id is assigned exactly once and each active issue id is assigned exactly once.
runtime: Recapture shipped camera coverage and screenshots at spawn, near, and after landmark approach plus cardinal/perimeter movement and dash; verify central building, Warden, landmarks, collision, and no disappearance or occlusion drift.

Run one fresh ordinary route using ordinary input only through all five wave ids, level-up drafts, Bellkeeper phases, Result, and Retry; separately exercise keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus paths and inspect authoritative transaction receipts.

On a native renderer at 1920x1080, execute three complete dense prepare/advance/reset cycles at 25-40 ordinary enemies with all weapon families, pickups, UI, VFX, lights, audio, and boss behavior; require stable frame-time distributions and no lifecycle growth. If native hardware is unavailable, retain the dense issue as pending rather than treating software evidence as qualification.
visual: Compare sparse shipped gameplay views against the bound reference for high-angle playable framing, coherent cemetery density, warm-versus-cool lighting, readable silhouettes, escape lanes, restrained effects, and compact authored HUD.

Inspect the level-up draft over gameplay for visual hierarchy, silhouettes or icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus, and absence of generic text-stacked or placeholder CURRENT values.

done_when: The shipped high-angle camera keeps the Warden, nearby threats, pickups, at least one escape lane, the central building, and other authored landmarks readable before, during, and after approach.

Camera visibility queries no longer classify GroundCollision or unrelated gameplay bodies as occluders; only explicitly bound tall landmark occluders may drive a bounded fade or sight-lane response, while gameplay collision remains authoritative.
The arena provides larger traversable scale or an explicit expand of the existing outer datum when needed, with coherent external world/external depth and no duplicated or replaced authored package.

Visible geometry and collision agree at the central building, landmark anchors, paths, and boundary/perimeter; ordinary movement or movement replay produces no pass-through, disappearance, or occlusion drift.
The camera remains stable through ordinary movement, dash, pause/resume, and dense combat without entering first-person, shoulder, or free-orbit modes.
tasks.instructions: Repair the camera/spatial root cause using an explicit camera-visibility contract: audit the coverage query mask and bound occluder/visual pairs, isolate camera probes from GroundCollision and other gameplay-only bodies, and use authored sight lanes or bounded transparency only for true tall occluders. Reconcile the native cemetery traversable datum, external world depth, central building/landmark placement, collision, and perimeter without replacing, splitting, hiding, or repositioning the intact authored package. Avoid another transform-tuning-only treatment. Keep camera-relative movement, dash, collision sliding, and pause ownership intact.
tasks.title: Restore camera-safe authored arena framing

done_when: A fresh ordinary run records first_toll, crossing_shadows, gravewind, long_procession, and bellkeeper in order with diagnostic_jump_count equal to zero, then reaches the Bellkeeper encounter, Result, and clean Retry.

The director changes composition across five data-driven waves, respects live caps and spawn budgets, requests the boss exactly once, exposes two phases and a readable recovery window, and stops spawning or transitioning after terminal state.

Every level-up opens exactly one interactive three-card transaction, pauses gameplay under the draft owner, debounces held confirm, applies the selected upgrade before resume, preserves experience overflow, and leaves an authoritative reset receipt.

Each choice uses visual hierarchy: silhouettes or icons lead the card, compact stat icons support the decision, current-to-new values are truthful, there are no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, unchanged rows are omitted, and NEW or LOCKED never appears as a CURRENT value.

Upgrade cards expose complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states plus hover, pressed, selected, and unavailable states; the selected card produces an observable next combat difference and focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area control remain distinct viable build shapes.

White-box state confirms ordinary_route_eligible is false for diagnostic jumps, terminal transition count is single-shot, and Retry clears actors, pause ownership, audio, drafts, and stale route state.
tasks.instructions: Replace fixture-only/evidence-only progression with a closure-ready authoritative ordinary route. Audit RunController and WaveDirector ownership so normal elapsed time and ordinary input advance all five authored waves, while tester/validation preparation remains editor-only, isolated, and unable to qualify the ordinary route. Integrate the level-up transaction with the upgrade presenter using visual hierarchy: silhouettes or icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus. Preserve the complete Bellkeeper terminal and Retry lifecycle.
tasks.title: Make ordinary route and build choices closure-ready

done_when: The dense profile remains editor-only and release-safe, retains native_renderer_three_cycle qualification, and never converts software or unknown renderer receipts into a pass.

Prepare, advance, and reset remain separate actions with requested, resolved, reset_isolation, branch, setup-generation, cycle, and advance-generation receipts; reset leaves no stale actors, signals, input actions, audio, lights, projectiles, pickups, or attack ledgers.

At the representative 25-40 enemy workload, candidate-side scheduling uses bounded deterministic buckets/cadences for steering, neighbor queries, presentation, lights, effects, and audio, with no full-group inventory scans or unbounded history growth.

Any source-level performance change is limited to a directly observed hotspot in the dense workload/lifecycle path; ordinary balance, weapon identity, and native renderer gate semantics remain untouched.

Sampling records nonzero frame and physics availability, p95/frame-time and high-water distributions, subsystem workload, and lifecycle deltas without making qualification depend on telemetry-only success.
tasks.instructions: Treat the open dense finding as an external native-host qualification gap, not permission for another evidence-only or verdict-changing treatment. Inspect the existing dense profile and workload owners, preserve the contract and renderer classification, and make only a narrow candidate repair if a concrete scheduler, pooling, or lifecycle hotspot is demonstrated. Keep all tester_dense controls unavailable in release exports and ensure three-cycle aggregation can be recaptured honestly on a native 1920x1080 host.
tasks.title: Keep dense workload bounded and native-gate honest
